overview: 本期共收录 12 篇论文。研究方向主要集中在金融经济学（8 篇）、资产定价（1 篇）、银行与信贷（1 篇）。方法上以数值模拟、回归分析为主。来源分布：arXiv（7 篇）、NBER（3 篇）、Semantic Scholar（2 篇）。其中 3 篇命中顶级期刊白名单。

papers.title: Functional Tensor Trains for High-Order Greeks and Exposure Tails of Multi-Asset Structured Products
papers.abstract: Risk management of worst-of autocallables needs price sensitivities (Greeks) up to third order and the potential future exposure, a tail quantile of the note's future value. In Monte Carlo, each order of differentiation multiplies the sampling noise by a factor that grows with the observation frequency, and nested simulation turns the noise of its inner paths into a bias of the quantile. We instead solve the backward pricing recursion, storing the continuation value as an $hp$ functional tensor train (hp-FTT) whose piecewise-polynomial cores are split at the barriers, so that worst-of barrier events act exactly, with rank one. For Gaussian transitions we show that the polynomial degree sufficient for an error $\varepsilon$ grows only as $\sqrt{\log(1/\varepsilon)}$. One solve then gives every Greek at any spot without sampling noise, by integrating the likelihood-ratio weight against the stored value, and the values it stores at future dates replace inner simulation. Against the strongest Monte Carlo estimators we could build or find published, on worst-of autocallables observed monthly on three to five assets, the order of the Greek and the accuracy decide which method is cheaper. At $1\%$ accuracy Monte Carlo is more than an order of magnitude cheaper for deltas, second-order Greeks go either way, and hp-FTT is cheaper for every third-order Greek, by up to two orders of magnitude. At $0.1\%$ hp-FTT is cheaper for every Greek we could check, under geometric Brownian motion and local volatility alike. For the exposure alone Monte Carlo is cheaper at $1\%$ and hp-FTT at $0.1\%$, and a solve run for the Greeks yields it for little more than scenario sampling. Sampling pays in variance for each derivative and hp-FTT in rank for each asset, so Monte Carlo keeps low-order Greeks at percent accuracy, rarely observed contracts and many assets.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】最差情况自动赎回型金融产品的风险管理需要价格敏感性参数（即希腊字母）的三阶导数，以及潜在的未来风险敞口——即该金融产品未来价值的尾部分位数。在蒙特卡洛模拟中，每一阶微分都会使采样噪声乘以一个随观测频率增加而增大的因子；而嵌套模拟则将内部路径的噪声转化为分位数的偏差。我们采用另一种方法：通过反向定价递归算法进行计算，并将连续价值存储为一个称为“hp-FTT”（hp-Functional Tensor Train）的数学结构。该结构的核心部分由分段多项式构成，在触发障碍条件时能够实现精确的数值计算（即阶数为1）。对于高斯过程下的资产价格变动，我们证明：为实现误差范围$\varepsilon$所需的多项式阶数仅与$\sqrt{\log(1/\varepsilon)}$成正比。通过将似然比权重积分到已存储的价值上，即可无需采样噪声即可计算出任意时刻的各个希腊字母参数；而hp-FTT在存储的未来日期值则可以替代内部模拟的结果。在与我们构建或找到的最强蒙特卡洛估计方法相比（这些方法用于观测三个月到五个月内价格变动的三到五种资产的最差情况自动赎回型金融产品），希腊字母参数的阶数和计算精度决定了...。研究方法：蒙特卡洛模拟、数值模拟。

papers.title: Valid GMM Inference with Non-parametrically Generated Discrete Type
papers.abstract: The recent progress in machine learning and classification methods has enabled researchers to predict economic discrete attributes that are not observed in standard datasets. These range from missing demographics, such as ethnicity and poverty status, to economic categories, such as innovative firms, metropolitan areas, occupational groups, binary treatment status, and counterfactual status. Although the plug-in procedure is widely used in empirical applications, nonparametric first-stage estimation recovering the labels can introduce regularization bias because of its slow convergence rate. Even if the double/debiased machine learning approach provides a way to correct the regularization bias, the according bias-correction term is not well defined in our problem, because even a small first-stage error can change the type discontinuously. To address this problem, we smooth the discontinuous type indicators using a smooth kernel function and a shrinking tuning parameter $b$. We then construct a well-defined Neyman-orthogonal score and define the appropriate debiased estimator. We show that this debiased estimator satisfies $\sqrt{Nb}$-consistency and asymptotic normality under regularity conditions. The slower $\sqrt{Nb}$ convergence rate is the cost of correcting the regularization bias when the nonparametric first-stage learner enters the moment function through discontinuous functions.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】近年来，机器学习和分类方法取得了显著进展，使得研究人员能够预测标准数据集中未包含的经济离散属性。这些属性涵盖了缺失的人口统计信息（如种族和贫困状况），以及经济分类（如创新型企业、大都市区、职业群体、二元处理状态和反事实状态）等。尽管插值法在实证应用中得到了广泛使用，但由于其收敛速度较慢，非参数第一阶段估计在恢复标签时可能会引入正则化偏差。即使双重/去偏机器学习方法能够纠正这种正则化偏差，但在我们的问题中，相应的偏差校正项并未得到明确定义，因为即使是很小的第一阶段误差也可能导致类型发生突变。为了解决这一问题，我们使用平滑核函数和收缩调整参数$b$来平滑这些类型指标的突变。随后，我们构建了一个定义明确的Neyman-正交得分，并定义了适当的去偏估计量。研究表明，在满足常规条件的情况下，该去偏估计量具有$\sqrt{Nb}$-一致性及渐近正态性。当非参数第一阶段学习器通过不连续函数影响矩函数时，较慢的$\sqrt{Nb}$收敛速度成为纠正正则化偏差的代价。。研究方法：机器学习。

papers.title: Factors Affecting the Participation of Small and Medium Enterprises (SMEs) in Foreign Trade: Empirical Evidence From SMEs in Lusaka, Zambia
papers.venue: Journal of Economics, Business, and Commerce
papers.abstract: The purpose of this study was to investigate the factors affecting the participation of Small and Medium Enterprises (SMEs) in foreign trade in Lusaka, Zambia. The objective was to establish how access to finance, regulatory and trade policy, and entrepreneurial knowledge affect the SMEs' trade participation. A quantitative research design was adopted, and 65 SMEs were selected using simple random sampling. Data were collected through structured questionnaires and analyzed using Megastat. The findings disclosed that SMEs' involvement in foreign trade was impacted by access to financing, with 32.3% reporting that 26%-50% of foreign transactions required external financing and 40% relying primarily on personal savings and family assistance. The SME category and reliance on outside funding were found to be significantly associated by chi-square test (X2=40.29, p-value <0.001). Participation was also found to be influenced by regulatory trade policy, especially through taxation, licensing requirements, certification standards, customs procedures, and compliance costs. The observed mean and the predicted value differed statistically significantly, according to a one-sample t-test (mean =2.600, t= -17.35). Although 41.5% reported that 1%-25% of management teams had received formal international trade training, entrepreneurial knowledge has a positive impact on participation in foreign trade. Knowledge of foreign market entry strategies and restrictions pertaining to international payment methods was significantly improved, according to a chi-square test (X2= 145.69,df=16, p <0.001). The findings imply that policy and practice should address financing barriers, regulatory complexity, and trade-related knowledge gaps to strengthen SMEs' international participation. The study comes to the conclusion that SMEs' participation in international trade can be increased by strengthening international trade, streamlining trade regulations, and expanding access to financing.
papers.summary_zh:
【资产定价】本研究的目的是探讨影响赞比亚卢萨卡地区中小企业（SMEs）参与对外贸易的各种因素。研究旨在分析融资渠道、监管政策与贸易政策以及企业家知识对中小企业贸易参与度的影响。研究采用定量研究方法，通过简单随机抽样选取了65家中小企业作为样本，并通过结构化问卷收集数据，随后利用Megastat软件对数据进行分析。

研究结果表明，中小企业的对外贸易参与情况受到融资条件的制约：32.3%的受访企业表示其26%至50%的对外贸易活动需要外部融资支持，而40%的企业主要依赖个人储蓄和家庭援助。卡方检验（X²=40.29，p值<0.001）显示，中小企业类型与其对外部资金的依赖程度之间存在显著关联。此外，监管政策（尤其是税收政策、许可要求、认证标准、海关程序及合规成本）也对企业的贸易参与度产生显著影响。单样本t检验结果显示（均值=2.600，t=-17.35），实际观察到的均值与预期值存在统计学上的显著差异。尽管41.5%的受访企业表示其管理团队中仅有1%至25%的人员接受过正式的国际贸易培训，但企业家知识对企业的对外贸易参与具有积极促进作用。卡方检验进一步表明（X²=145.69，df=16，p<...。

papers.title: A Study on the Impact of Banking Fintech on the Continuous Innovation of Specialized, Refined, Distinctive, and Innovative Enterprises
papers.venue: Advances in Economics, Management and Political Sciences
papers.abstract: "Specialized, Refined, Distinctive, and Innovative" (SRDI) enterprises have long focused on niche markets, but their sustained innovation is often affected by external financing conditions, given their long R&D cycles, technological risks, and delays in commercializing research outcomes. As commercial banks increasingly integrate data, algorithms, and digital infrastructure into lending operations, the way they assess innovation-related information and allocate technology-related loans has changed. Research in this area has therefore moved beyond loan availability to examine loan terms, financing costs, and innovation quality. This paper distinguishes between regional digital finance, platform-based fintech, and bank-internal fintech. It reviews existing research on how bank fintech relates to the sustained innovation of SRDI enterprises, with particular attention to loan terms, risk pricing, and their applicable conditions. Existing research suggests that bank fintech can supplement traditional financial and collateral information, thereby improving financing conditions for asset-light enterprises; studies on "Specialized, Refined, Unique, and New" enterprises have found that digital finance and fintech organizations help sustain R&D activities and drive key technological breakthroughs. However, existing studies still face limitations in matching bank and enterprise data, identifying loan contracts, and measuring sustained innovation. Whether the application of fintech can generate long-term innovation returns through adjustments in loan terms and pricing requires further examination based on the integration of enterprise, bank, loan, and patent data.
papers.summary_zh: 【银行与信贷】“专业化、精细化、差异化及创新性”（SRDI）企业长期以来一直专注于细分市场，但由于其研发周期较长、技术风险较高以及研究成果商业化存在延迟，其持续创新能力常常受到外部融资条件的影响。随着商业银行越来越多地将数据、算法和数字基础设施融入贷款业务，它们评估与创新相关的信息以及分配技术相关贷款的方式也随之发生了变化。因此，该领域的研究已从单纯关注贷款的可获得性，扩展到对贷款条款、融资成本和创新质量的探讨。本文区分了区域数字金融、基于平台的金融科技以及银行内部的金融科技，并回顾了现有研究，探讨了银行金融科技如何促进SRDI企业的持续创新，特别关注贷款条款、风险定价及其适用条件。现有研究表明，银行金融科技能够补充传统的财务信息和抵押品信息，从而改善轻资产企业的融资条件；针对“专业化、精细化、独特及创新性”企业的研究发现，数字金融和金融科技组织有助于维持研发活动并推动关键的技术突破。然而，现有研究在匹配银行与企业数据、识别贷款合同以及衡量持续创新能力方面仍存在局限性。金融科技的应用是否能够通过调整贷款条款和定价来产生长期创新回报，还需要结合企业、银行、贷款和专利数据进一步研究。。

papers.title: Can Home Visits Re-Engage Chronically Absent Students? Evidence from the LEAP Program
papers.abstract: Beginning in the summer of 2021, the state of Connecticut launched the Learner Engagement and Attendance Program (LEAP) where home visits by school personnel were conducted with students identified as chronically absent from Connecticut’s 15 most disadvantaged school districts. Home visits were designed to connect students and their families directly with teachers to foster strong connections. We use student-level data from 2021–22 through 2023-24 to estimate event studies of the effect of LEAP on student attendance, chronic absenteeism, disciplinary incidents, and student achievement. Utilizing models that address selection into treatment timing over student observable and unobservable attributes, we find that students who received the LEAP intervention experienced approximately a 4 to 5 percentage point increase in attendance rates, a 13 to 15 percentage point decline in chronic absenteeism, and a 3 to 5 percentage point decline in the number of disciplinary incidents. Notably, initial event studies indicated increasing treatment effects over time, but after correcting for selection on unobservables treatment effects appeared constant over time. These effects were broad based, with similar impacts by gender, race and ethnicity, and free or reduced-price lunch status. These attendance and discipline results provide suggest that the LEAP intervention increased student noncognitive skills.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】自2021年夏季起，康涅狄格州推出了“学习者参与与出勤计划”（Learner Engagement and Attendance Program，简称LEAP）。该计划要求学校工作人员对来自该州15个最贫困学区的长期缺勤学生进行家访，旨在帮助学生及其家庭与教师建立直接联系，从而促进良好的师生关系。我们利用2021-2022年度至2023-2024年度的学生数据，对该计划对学生出勤率、长期缺勤情况、纪律问题以及学业成绩的影响进行了分析。通过运用能够考虑学生在可观测和不可观测属性方面的选择偏倚的模型，我们发现接受LEAP干预的学生出勤率提高了约4%至5%，长期缺勤率下降了13%至15%，纪律问题发生的次数减少了3%至5%。值得注意的是，初步的研究结果显示干预效果随时间有所增强，但在控制了不可观测因素的选择偏倚后，干预效果趋于稳定。这些积极变化具有普遍性，无论学生的性别、种族、族裔背景，或是是否享受免费或优惠午餐政策，其影响均无明显差异。这些数据表明，LEAP干预措施有助于提升学生的非认知能力。。

papers.title: Unraveling the Cobweb of Global Imbalances: Drivers, Vulnerabilities and Adjustment Scenarios
papers.abstract: This paper analyses the evolution and drivers of the stock of global imbalances in order to assess associated vulnerabilities and potential adjustment scenarios. These imbalances have recently increased sharply, with a deterioration in the US net international investment position (NIIP) mirrored by NIIP improvements in most other major economies. We decompose these NIIP changes into their proximate drivers for a sample of 28 economies and find that financial factors (including valuation changes and investment income flows) are the primary drivers of global imbalances at both short and long horizons, while trade also plays a significant role (especially at long horizons). Valuation gains on international investment positions have supported economic growth in many countries since 2010, while also increasing their vulnerability to financial market adjustments. To assess the implications and potential risks, we simulate the spillovers through this cobweb of global imbalances from: (i) a sharp dollar depreciation, (ii) a repricing of equity markets, (iii) higher interest rates, and (iv) a halving of trade imbalances. These scenarios highlight the large international spillovers that would be associated with any reduction in global imbalances, the heterogeneous impact of various rebalancing mechanisms on individual countries and the limits of popular proposals for reducing these imbalances. The persistence of global imbalances underscores the importance of building resilience to the large spillovers that can occur through this cobweb of international exposures.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】本文分析了全球失衡状况的演变及其驱动因素，旨在评估由此产生的脆弱性及可能的调整路径。近年来，全球失衡现象显著加剧，其中美国的净国际投资头寸（NIIP）持续恶化，而大多数其他主要经济体的NIIP状况则有所改善。我们对28个经济体的NIIP变化进行了分解，发现金融因素（包括估值变动和投资收入流动）是短期和长期内全球失衡的主要驱动因素；贸易也在其中发挥了重要作用（尤其是在长期）。自2010年以来，国际投资头寸的估值上涨推动了许多国家的经济增长，但同时也增加了这些国家对金融市场波动的敏感性。为了评估这些失衡现象可能带来的影响和风险，我们模拟了以下四种情景下的全球失衡传导效应：（1）美元急剧贬值；（2）股市重新定价；（3）利率上升；（4）贸易失衡减半。这些情景表明，任何形式的全球失衡减少都会引发巨大的国际连锁反应，不同再平衡机制对各国的影响各不相同，同时现有的一些减少失衡的提议也存在局限性。全球失衡的持续存在凸显了增强抵御这些国际风险传导能力的重要性。。

papers.title: When is the deepest drawdown also the longest?
papers.abstract: Does the deepest drawdown take the longest to recover? For random walks with iid increments of positive finite mean, we find that the deepest and longest episodes are eventually distinct almost surely under light-tailed losses, but coincide with probability tending to one under heavy-tailed losses. More precisely, when losses have a finite exponential moment, the deepest episode's duration, relative to the longest among $n$ episodes, converges in probability to an explicit $ρ\in(0,1)$, while its descending duration rank is $n^{1-ρ+o_{\mathbb{P}}(1)}$. These limits hold for every fixed number of leading depths; in the Gaussian model, $ρ=1/2$, independently of drift and variance. The separation reflects the different exponential costs of reaching a large depth and sustaining a long episode. For regularly varying losses, a common large loss governs both depth and duration: the duration ratio tends to one almost surely, and for every fixed $k$, the $k$ deepest and $k$ longest episodes have the same indices in the same order with probability tending to one. For any $k_n\to\infty$ with $k_n=o(n)$, the proportion of common episodes among the $k_n$ deepest and $k_n$ longest converges in probability to zero in the light-tailed case and to one in the heavy-tailed case. These ranking laws also hold for completed drawdowns within a deterministic observation horizon.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】最深的亏损是否需要最长的时间才能恢复？对于具有独立同分布（iid）且均值为正的随机增量过程，我们发现，在轻尾损失情况下，最深和持续时间最长的亏损事件最终几乎可以确定地是不同的；而在重尾损失情况下，这两种事件以概率趋近于1的方式重合。更准确地说，当损失具有有限的指数矩时，最深亏损事件的持续时间相对于所有$n$个亏损事件中的最长事件而言，其概率收敛于一个具体的值$ρ\in(0,1)$；同时，该事件在亏损持续时间排名中的位置为$n^{1-ρ+o_{\mathbb{P}}(1)}$。这些结论适用于任意固定的最大亏损深度数量；在高斯模型中，无论漂移项和方差如何变化，$ρ$始终为$1/2$。这种差异反映了达到较大亏损深度与维持长时间亏损之间的不同成本。对于具有规律变化幅度的损失，一次较大的亏损同时决定了亏损的深度和持续时间：持续时间的比例几乎可以确定地趋近于1；对于任意固定的$k$，最深的$k$个事件和持续时间最长的$k$个事件按照相同的顺序排列，其概率也趋近于1。对于任意满足$k_n=o(n)$的$k_n\to\infty$的情况，在轻尾损失情况下，最深的$k_n$个事件与持续时间最长的$...。

papers.title: Zero Crossings on the Accuracy-Smoothness Frontier: Maximal Monotone and Minimal Inflection Non Stationary Predictors
papers.abstract: The Smooth Sign Accuracy (SSA) framework resolves the smoothness--accuracy dilemma for stationary predictors by balancing mean squared error (MSE) against the frequency of sign changes. We generalize it to non-stationary integrated processes (I-SSA), deriving MSE-optimal predictors constrained by the expected duration between turning points (I(1)) or inflection points (I(2)). The resulting maximal-monotone and minimal-inflection predictors, filters, and smoothers customize classic benchmarks along a new efficient Accuracy--Smoothness (AS) frontier. Tracking the identity (the original data) along this frontier defines the \emph{I-SSA trend}, a novel smoothing concept that, unlike classical filters, imposes no artificial structure on the data-generating process and is directly interpretable through explicit control of turning- or inflection-point frequency. The optimization is a quadratically constrained quadratic program (QCQP) that reduces to a Generalized Trust Region Subproblem (GTRS) with hidden convexity. On its feasible, invertible region the problem is convex with a well-defined global optimum, and an exact closed-form expression delivers the efficient AS frontier. Under fairly general assumptions, finite-sample solutions converge to an asymptotic I-SSA predictor, devoid of integration boundary perturbations. The framework unifies mean squared error on non-stationary levels, and sign accuracy, zero-crossing frequency, and target correlation on stationary differences.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】平滑符号精度（SSA）框架通过平衡均方误差（MSE）与符号变化频率，解决了平稳预测变量在平滑性与准确性之间的矛盾。我们将该框架推广到非平稳积分过程（I-SSA），提出了受转折点间预期持续时间（I(1)）或拐点间预期持续时间（I(2)）约束的MSE最优预测器。由此产生的最大单调预测器、最小拐点预测器、滤波器及平滑器，为经典的性能评估指标构建了一条新的、高效的“准确性-平滑性”（AS）前沿。沿着这条前沿追踪原始数据，可以定义出一种新颖的平滑方法——I-SSA趋势。与传统滤波器不同，I-SSA趋势不会对数据生成过程施加人为结构，并且可以通过对转折点或拐点频率的显式控制来实现直接解释。该优化问题属于二次约束二次规划（QCQP）类型，可转化为具有隐式凸性的广义信赖域子问题（GTRS）。在其可行且可逆的解域内，问题具有凸性且存在明确的全局最优解；通过精确的封闭形式表达式，可以得出高效的AS前沿。在较为一般的假设条件下，有限样本解能够收敛到渐近的I-SSA预测器，且不受积分边界扰动的影响。该框架统一了非平稳情况下的均方误差评估方法，以及平稳情况下的符号准确性、零交叉频率和目标相关性分析方法。。研究方法：优化方法。

papers.title: Evaluating Maternity Leave Reforms When RD Fails
papers.abstract: This paper documents that expansions of UK maternity pay in the 2000s improved children's test scores while reducing maternal employment. Extending job protection alone generated similar employment effects but no detectable impact on children. None of these effects are recoverable with a conventional regression discontinuity (RD) design because eligibility is only imperfectly captured by the available data. We explain why existing corrections for measurement error in RD are not well suited and propose a simple imputation-based solution. The approach preserves RD's main advantages, nonparametric identification and transparency, and remains valid even when measurement error has economic content.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】本文研究表明，2000年代英国 maternity pay（产假津贴）的增加提高了儿童的考试成绩，但同时减少了母亲的就业率。仅扩大就业保护措施也能产生类似的就业效应，但对儿童的学习成绩没有显著影响。由于现有数据无法完全准确反映资格认定情况，这些效应无法通过传统的回归不连续性（Regression Discontinuity, RD）方法进行修正。我们分析了现有RD误差修正方法的不适用性，并提出了一种基于插补的简单解决方案。该方法保留了RD方法的主要优势，即非参数估计和透明性，并且即使在测量误差具有经济含义的情况下依然有效。。研究方法：断点回归、回归分析。

papers.title: A New GAUSS Software Component for Implementing Dynamic Tests of Contagion with an Application
papers.abstract: The main goal of this article is to present a new software component created by the authors in GAUSS for implementing dynamic tests for contagion. These tests are aimed at providing the possibilities of testing for spiller-over effects between financial markets during a crisis or during a pandemic situation such as the one that we experienced recently. Unlike standard tests for contagion that have fixed dates for a potential shift, the tests implemented here are dynamic in the sense that the potential contagion effect is measured across the time span. The leverage bootstrap simulation technique is utilized in order to generate critical values that are reliable when the tests are implemented in order to make sure that the conducted inference is accurate. Since the approach is new, software component needs to be created for conducting the underlying tests, which is accomplished via this article. The module is very easy to implement by the general practitioners via a graphical user interface. An application is offered by using real data from stock markets in order to demonstrate how the software component can be used.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】本文的主要目的是介绍作者在GAUSS中开发的一个新软件组件，该组件用于实现动态传染性测试。这些测试旨在评估金融危机或类似近期疫情这样的突发公共卫生事件期间金融市场之间的传染效应。与那些具有固定潜在变化日期的标准传染性测试不同，本文所实现的测试具有动态性，即传染效应是在整个时间跨度内进行测量的。为了生成可靠的临界值以确保推断结果的准确性，采用了杠杆自助法（leverage bootstrap）模拟技术。由于这种方法属于创新性尝试，因此需要专门开发相应的软件组件来执行这些测试，而这正是本文所要完成的内容。该模块通过图形用户界面（GUI）使得普通用户能够非常便捷地使用。文章还提供了基于真实股市数据的应用实例，以展示该软件组件的实际应用方式。。研究方法：数值模拟。

papers.title: Covariance Identification from Regression Residuals
papers.abstract: Regression residuals are projections of the errors, not observations of them. This paper characterizes what residuals identify about the error covariance. Residualization acts on the covariance through a known linear map, and under an unrestricted covariance model the directions it destroys are exactly those generated by the column space of the regressors. A linear covariance functional is identified if and only if it does not load on these lost directions, and restricting the covariance model, for instance to diagonal or clustered form, shrinks them. The central result separates projection loss from moment-selection loss: projecting the residual covariance onto the maintained covariance structure loses no identifying information, so cross-cluster, long-lag, and long-distance residual products add no identifying directions. They can still improve conditioning, since restricting to the aligned moments squares the condition number. This equivalence relies on the orthogonal-projection geometry of OLS, and generally fails for non-orthogonal transformation. Quadratic statistics in the outcome that are free of the regression coefficients additionally identify the covariance between the fitted and residual components, but not the covariance within the span of the regressors. Because the OLS sandwich variance depends only on that block, it is not identified by any such statistic under an unrestricted covariance model; robust variance estimation draws its identification from maintained restrictions on the covariance structure.
papers.summary_zh: 【风险管理与衍生品】回归残差实际上是误差的投影，而非误差的观测值本身。本文探讨了残差在揭示误差协方差特征方面的作用。残差化过程通过一个已知的线性映射作用于协方差结构；在无约束的协方差模型下，这种映射所破坏的协方差方向正是由回归量构成的列空间所生成的那些方向。一个线性协方差泛函只有在不依赖于这些被破坏的方向时，才能被有效识别；通过对协方差模型进行限制（例如将其限制为对角形式或聚类形式），这些被破坏的方向会被进一步缩减。本文的核心结论区分了“投影损失”与“矩选择损失”：将残差协方差投影到保留的协方差结构上并不会丢失任何用于识别误差特征的信息；因此，跨簇、长滞后或长距离的残差乘积并不会引入新的识别方向。尽管如此，这些残差乘积仍能改善数据的条件数（即数据的稳定性），因为仅保留相关矩值可以使条件数趋于平方。这种等价性依赖于普通最小二乘法（OLS）中的正交投影几何特性，但在非正交变换情况下则不再成立。结果变量中那些不包含回归系数的二次统计量虽然能够揭示拟合部分与残差部分之间的协方差，却无法揭示回归量所张成空间内的协方差。由于OLS方法中的方差估计仅依赖于该特定块数据，因此在无约束的协方差模型下，任何此类统计量都...。研究方法：回归分析。

papers.title: Affirmative Action, Faculty Productivity and Caste Interactions: Evidence from Engineering Colleges in India
papers.abstract: Affirmative action programs are often criticized because of concerns that they result in lower worker productivity and efficiency losses. We study the relative productivity of workers benefiting from an aggressive affirmative action policy in a setting where hiring constraints are mandated upon employers and are typically likely to bind. In India, colleges are required to reserve approximately 50 percent of faculty hires for individuals from disadvantaged caste and social class groups. We collect and analyze data from a nationally representative sample of 50 engineering and technology colleges in India, some of which randomly assign students to classrooms. We find that reservation category faculty have lower levels of education, lower professorial ranks and fewer years of experience in academia than general category faculty who are not hired through reservations. Yet, even with lower qualifications, we do not detect meaningful differences in instructional quality between reservation category faculty and general category faculty across a wide range of measures that include course grades, follow-on course grades, standardized test scores, dropout, attendance, graduate school plans, and graduation. In fact, we find that, at least for immediate effects on course grades, students taught by reservation category faculty perform slightly better than students taught by general category faculty. We also estimate “teacher-like-me” effects of reservation category faculty on the relative course performance and longer-term outcomes of reservation category students and cannot reject the hypothesis of null effects. Furthermore, even in the face of potential discrimination and resentment against faculty hiring quotas, general category students perform slightly better in classrooms taught by reservation category faculty than general category faculty. Finally, estimates of differences between reservation category and general category faculty in several measures of research productivity and administrative service are small in magnitude and not statistically different from zero. The findings have implications for the heated debates over affirmative action programs found in many countries around the world and in India which is now the largest country in the world.
papers.summary_zh: 【公司金融】平权行动计划常常受到批评，因为人们担心这些计划会导致员工生产力下降和效率损失。我们研究了在雇主必须遵守招聘限制（且这些限制通常具有约束力的情况下）中，受益于积极平权行动政策的员工的相对生产力。在印度，各大学被要求为来自弱势种姓和社会阶层的群体预留约50%的教职岗位。我们收集并分析了来自印度50所具有代表性的工程和技术学院的数据，其中一些学院会随机将学生分配到不同的教学班级中。研究发现，通过招聘配额录用的教师在教育水平、教授职称以及学术经验方面均低于未通过配额录用的普通教师。然而，尽管资格较低，我们在包括课程成绩、后续课程成绩、标准化考试分数、辍学率、出勤率、研究生升学计划以及毕业情况在内的多个指标上，并未发现这两类教师在教学质量上存在显著差异。事实上，至少在课程成绩这一指标上，由配额教师授课的学生表现略优于由普通教师授课的学生。我们还评估了配额教师对学生相对课程表现及长期发展影响的效应，但无法排除这些效应为零的可能性。此外，即使存在对教师招聘配额的歧视和不满情绪，由配额教师授课的班级中，普通学生的表现也略优于由普通教师授课的班级。最后，我们在研究生产力和行政服务等多个指标上测得的...。
